benchmarks.baseline: The normal hours of work of any employee shall not exceed eight hours in a day. Employers must grant at least sixty minutes time-off for regular meals.
It shall be the duty of every employer to provide each of his employees a rest period of not less than twenty-four consecutive hours after every six consecutive normal work days.
Wages shall be paid in legal tender and the use of tokens or chits is prohibited. Payment shall be made at least once every two weeks or twice a month at intervals not exceeding sixteen days.
An employee shall not be terminated except for a just cause or when authorized by law. Termination requires at least one month advance notice or payment in lieu of notice.
A female employee is entitled to 14 weeks of paid maternity leave. The employer must not terminate the contract during pregnancy except for summary dismissal.

Female employees are entitled to maternity leave for the first four deliveries. Every employee who has rendered at least one year of service is entitled to a service incentive leave of five days with pay.
